text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inherited from my mentor and carried forward with Gran Alegria—
our 'Umamusume First' philosophy—"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—The next question is from an elementary school Umamusume.
She asks, 'Do I need to train a lot to win a GⅠ?'

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to training volume or training hours,
that's not necessarily the case."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: In my team's case, for instance, the time spent on the field was short.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: "I think it's much more meaningful to focus intensely on your assignments for that short period of time."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Even if it's light, consistency is key... It's important to keep up with daily training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! What a great question from the elementary schooler~!
That's a nice assist for Master!
choice_data_list: I hope you can put it to good use in training.
Hope it comes in handy for your training!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can see Master on the news and in
videos all the time, so I don't feel lonely at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After retiring, he shared stories from his days as a Trainer through the media.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Knowing that your videos have sparked interest in our work as well—"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of sharing and reaching out
even more actively than before.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It may lead to the development of the racing world.
...That is something I learned from all of you.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've parted ways with Master—
the future we're aiming for is the same!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps our paths will cross again
further down the line!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This is where the event's being held, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty big... I wonder if people will come.
If it's empty, I'll be 20 Miles of Sadness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is a fan meetup event.
Thanks to Gran Alegria's video, requests for
events like this have been increasing lately.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: They must have made the offer expecting a decent turnout anyway. It'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I see. Then you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Will it really be okay...!?
Who'd want to come see just regular girls like us...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If Ai-san were with us, that would've been so reassuring...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Gran-chan!
Love-chan and the others are here too! Everyone's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Is that someone who came for the event?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good Mile-niiing!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Good Mile-ning!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! I got an in-person "Good morn-mile"!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for interrupting your rehearsal!
I'm really looking forward to the event♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ohh, they replied to my Good Morning Mile!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, see, Chrono-chan?
There really were spectators, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I-If that's the case, then I'll have to do my best not to disappoint them!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're too tense, way too tense!
Didn't they tell us to just be ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However, if it's just the two of us talking,
would that really be... entertaining...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Shall we prepare something like a script...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't think we need a script!
Sounds like we can just chat casually like we always do!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"They say everyone wants to know about our daily lives,
outside of racing!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If that makes them happy, maybe they'll get even more interested in racing, too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: For a happy future for Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "The cheers of all the fans are an indispensable part of it, after all!"
